resources.string: Check your internet connection, then try again.
That user name and password don\'t match an account. Check them and try again.
Too many attempts to sign in. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
PuzzleQuest couldn\'t accept that. Check your user name and password, then try again.
Can\'t reach PuzzleQuest. Check your internet connection, then try again.
Something went wrong at PuzzleQuest. Try again in a moment.
New to PuzzleQuest? Sign up on the website
Couldn\'t load your quests. Check your connection and try again.
Please verify your email address: follow the link in the email we sent you.
The email has been sent several times lately. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Your tools are on the website
Signed in as %1$s. This app is for players; staff and administrators use PuzzleQuest on the website.
Set for this run by the PQ_SERVER_URL intent extra.
The app checks it\'s a PuzzleQuest server before using it.
This app connects only to PuzzleQuest\'s own servers: thepuzzlequest.com and addresses ending in .thepuzzlequest.com.
That isn\'t a server\'s address. Enter one such as https://staging.thepuzzlequest.com.
A server\'s address starts with https:// (or http:// for a test server).
A server\'s address can\'t include a user name or password.
Enter only the server\'s address, with nothing after its name, such as https://staging.thepuzzlequest.com.
PuzzleQuest\'s servers use secure connections: the address must start with https://.
PuzzleQuest\'s servers don\'t use a port number. Leave out the colon and the number after the name.
Can\'t reach that server. Check the address and your internet connection, then try again.
That isn\'t a PuzzleQuest server. Check the address, then try again.
That server runs a version of PuzzleQuest this app can\'t use.
Switching to %1$s signs you out of %2$s.
